reviewed_by: Claude idle-retirement implementer for #1113; both defects independently reproduced on 7495a04 by a separate Claude validation subagent (issues/idle-retirement/validation.md) before the fix; an independent diff review is still required before merge
reason: Core fix for #1113. (1) Idle retirement skipped a worker whose release lacks project.idle-retirement/v1 (or whose process/release row is missing) without any record, so resident older-release workers looked leaked; RuntimeAutoAdmission now records one forced info diagnostic runtime.idle_retirement.skipped per worker, project and reason, and still never retires it (#1111 demand rules unchanged). (2) ExecutionWorker._prepare_quiescence, used by idle retirement and host-shutdown quiescence, ignored a follow-up claim in queue._inflight and a Butler action in _dispatching that the handoff checkpoint already refuses; both paths now share ProjectHandoffAgent.dispatch_blockers, read before and again after the SQL quiesce checkpoint, so the worker refuses with quiesce_blockers and the host aborts the retirement hold instead of stranding the claim. Python: new tests/v3/test_idle_retirement_dispatch.py (the queue, Butler and silent-skip cases, all failing on 7495a04), a new handoff test for the Butler blocker, and the handoff, quiescence and mixed-release idle-retirement files whose fake agents gained dispatch_blockers. Playwright: the two real-Core journeys that retire idle project workers through the changed quiesce gate, desktop only.
exclusions: No UI, frontend unit, native or settings changes; the diagnostic appears through the existing diagnostics surface and no setting or assistant destination is added. No admission hold row is written for a skipped worker: that row means a wanted worker is starting and would mislead views. Mobile 390/320/430 and compact Playwright profiles are excluded because no layout or client code changes; the retained-continuity process acceptance and handoff journeys are excluded because the handoff checkpoint behavior is unchanged (only refactored into the shared helper, covered by test_project_handoff_agent.py).
